meta.title: Damicon - farm management for the raspberry plantation
meta.description: Damicon is the farm-management system for a raspberry farm near Almaty: the harvest run, the cold chain with a 60-minute threshold, crate identity in the field, contribution margin per harvest day and an unbroken chain of evidence for every delivery.

hero.badge: Farm management for the raspberry plantation · near Almaty
hero.headline: Market leadership is won not through tonnage, but through verifiable traceability.
hero.subheadline: The raspberry has no protective skin and has to be cooled within 60 minutes. Damicon controls the multi-week harvest run, holds the cold chain and documents every delivery down to the row block, the cooling time and the person.
hero.imageAlt: Trellised rows of a raspberry plantation - placeholder image, to be replaced with real material from the farm
hero.stat1Label: hard limit from picking to pre-cooling
hero.stat2Label: picking cycle per row block in the autumn window
hero.stat3Label: price gap between loose fresh ware and same-day premium

landing.berryTitle: The most delicate berry in the fresh-produce range
landing.berryLead: It has no protective skin, is hollow inside and highly prone to grey mould. Software alone saves no berry - but it runs exactly the hour, the rotation and the records that the price depends on.

schale.title: No protective skin
schale.text: Unrefrigerated, the raspberry is no longer marketable after about a day. Properly pre-cooled it keeps two to three days, up to five with excellent handling.

kuehlung.title: 60 minutes to cooling
kuehlung.text: No more than 60 minutes may pass between picking and cooling. Break that limit and every further measure is worthless.

umpacken.title: Pick straight into the retail punnet
umpacken.text: The retail-ready punnet is made in the picker's hand. Any repacking or re-sorting destroys the goods.

feld.title: Quality is decided in the field
feld.text: The quality call happens at the picker. It has to be captured and measured there, not at a central sorting station.

rhythmus.title: A conveyor belt, not a peak
rhythmus.text: Everbearing varieties bear from August to the first frost. Every row block is picked every two to three days, over three to eight weeks.

schaden.title: One berry devalues the punnet
schaden.text: A single leaking or damaged berry makes the whole punnet unsellable. A pure piece rate is therefore value-destroying.

landing.berryQuote: A peak you survive with many hands. A conveyor belt over six weeks you survive only with a plan.
landing.spreadEyebrow: The price spread is the business case
landing.spreadTitle: Between loose ware and premium lies a factor of 2.3
landing.spreadLead: The Almaty market pays about 1,500 tenge per kilogram for loose fresh ware off the field, and up to 3,500 tenge for ware picked and marketed on the same day. The difference is not made in the field.

lose.label: Loose fresh ware off the field
lose.note: Sold from the field and via classifieds. Impossible to undercut on price.

schale.label: Punnet ware, tunnel / greenhouse
schale.note: Polka and Babje leto varieties. The punnet creates the premium, not the berry.

premium.label: Premium, picked the same day
premium.note: Marketed directly. Freshness, consistency and verifiability are the entire added value.

landing.spreadFactorText: That much extra revenue per season comes from every 10-percentage-point shift of volume into the upper price segment - at three hectares. The lever is cooling time, punnet quality, delivery reliability and verifiability.
landing.proofTitle: An unbroken chain of evidence for every delivery
landing.proofLead: The farm that is the only one able to trace every delivery back to the row block, the cooling time and the person becomes the standard against which trade measures the others.

kuehlkurve.title: Cooling curve
kuehlkurve.text: Time and temperature from picking to pre-cooling, a hard 60-minute limit, temperature logger all the way to the client.

charge.title: Batch
charge.text: Every crate carries an identifier assigned in the field and belongs to exactly one batch - from the crate to the invoice.

herkunftsblock.title: Source block
herkunftsblock.text: Row block, variety and harvest day as cost object and origin declaration per batch.

pfluecker.title: Picker
pfluecker.text: Volume, row block, time and person are captured in one scan when the crate is handed over.

behandlung.title: Treatment record
behandlung.text: Every plant-protection treatment locks the row block automatically until the pre-harvest interval expires. Residue proof per batch at the press of a button.

landing.proofClosing: On a complaint it can be established within seconds which block, which person and which cooling time the ware came from.
landing.leversLead: Each lever stands on its own, but they build on each other. Without the first, the other three are worthless.

stunde.title: The hour after picking
stunde.text: Fixed collection rounds, pre-cooling at 0 to 1 degree, timing with a 60-minute threshold. The price difference collapses in the first hour in the field, not in the sales conversation.

herbstfenster.title: The autumn window
herbstfenster.text: With everbearing varieties the autumn yield is the main yield, and regional supply is thin. The rotation plan holds picking discipline over six weeks - one missed round destroys the block for that cycle.

zugang.title: Traceability as an access advantage
zugang.text: Large retail chains only take on verifiable suppliers. Anyone who can show the chain from crate to invoice becomes reachable for these buyers in the first place. The regulatory burden turns into an advantage.

aggregation.title: Aggregation instead of buying land
aggregation.text: Own harvest and buy-in from neighbouring farms under one brand, one quality class and continuous traceability - with separate batch tracking per farm. Growth without buying land.

landing.zonesLead: From the row-block map to the B2B portal, from the cold-chain clock to the contribution margin per harvest day. All areas share the same batch and the same role management.
landing.kpiLead: Measured during the analysis week and signed off together as the starting value. Without signed starting values there is no proof of success later.
landing.kpiFootnote: Prototype: placeholder values. The real calculation follows with the harvest data of the first fully measured season.
landing.complianceTitle: The regulatory burden turns into an access advantage
landing.complianceLead: In 2026 Kazakhstan reset the legal framework for digital matters in a series of laws. For a farm that fully meets these obligations, the burden becomes the entry ticket to organised trade.

steuer.title: Tax Code 2026
steuer.text: VAT 16 %, registration threshold at 43.25 million tenge. A growing farm slips into the tax obligation - without a clean chain of records that is a risk.

warenbegleit.title: Electronic goods-accompanying document
warenbegleit.text: Since 01 Jan 2026 every delivery is documented electronically via the ЭСФ system. The accompanying document is the central goods and accounting record, paper only on failure.

ki.title: AI Act No. 230-VIII
ki.text: The AI chat needs a visible transparency notice, purpose-bound consent, logging and escalation to a human. Emotion analysis is prohibited.

digitalkodex.title: Digital Code No. 255-VIII
digitalkodex.text: Restricts the storage of certain data products outside Kazakhstan. The hosting location is reviewed legally before going live.

datenschutz.title: Tightened data-protection law
datenschutz.text: Since 24 Aug 2026: purpose-bound consent, retention periods, named controllers, encryption, multi-factor authentication, annual mandatory training.

esutd.title: ЕСУТД employment-contract registration
esutd.text: The start, change and end of every seasonal contract is recorded in the unified system. Often not done for seasonal workers today - a risk of up to 2,000 MRP.

landing.complianceClosing: Large chains with their own supply chain only take on suppliers who can produce evidence. Compliance here is not a formality but the admission ticket.
landing.ctaTitle: A tangible system instead of concept slides
landing.ctaLead: The prototype shows the structure and look of the first release: row-block control with the pre-harvest-interval lock, picking tasks with photo evidence, the cold-chain clock and contribution margin per harvest day.
landing.faqTitle: Six questions that always come up in the first meeting
landing.faqLead: Short answers with the figures shown on this page.

sechzig.a: No more than 60 minutes may pass between picking and cooling down. Once that limit is missed, every later measure is ineffective - which is why the system measures this span per batch, not as a daily average.

durchgang.q: What happens if a picking pass is missed?
durchgang.a: Every row block is picked every two to three days, across three to eight weeks. A missed pass destroys that block for the cycle. The rotation plan keeps the order and shows the gap on the same day.

beleg.a: Every crate carries an identifier assigned in the field and belongs to exactly one batch. Row block, variety, harvest day, picking time, cooling curve and treatment record hang on it - through to the electronic delivery note in the ЭСФ system.

rollen.a: The role of the signed-in account decides, and it decides in the database, not in the interface. Seven core roles from administration to the individual picker; a gap in the frontend therefore exposes no foreign data.

stand.a: {gesamt} modules across four areas: {angebunden} on the database with real writes, {demo} as a usable demo, {entwicklung} as visible menu entries under development. The figures on the start page are placeholders until the first fully measured season.

daten.a: Digital Code No. 255-VIII restricts storing certain data products outside Kazakhstan. The hosting location is therefore reviewed legally before going live; keys and credentials never live in the source code.

feld.name: Field
feld.description: Location model, row-block status including the pre-harvest-interval lock, picking tasks with photo evidence, rotation plan and weather link.

hof.name: Yard
hof.description: Pre-cooling with a 60-minute KPI, temperature logger, collection rounds, QR crate identification and electronic delivery note.

buero.name: Office
buero.description: Roles and permissions, contribution margin per row block and harvest day, quality-factor pay, document management, compliance cockpit and the state integrations.

markt.name: Market
markt.description: Variety and quota catalogue, B2B portal with pre-order, AI chat on a secured data basis, aggregator platform for neighbouring farms and multilingual training.

footer.blurb: Damicon is the farm-management system for a raspberry farm near Almaty - from the harvest run through the cold chain to the evidence for every delivery.
footer.prototypeNote: Internal proof of concept. Not a contractually committed scope. Farm photos show the real site near Almaty; all other images are illustrations or placeholders.

error.code: The code is wrong or expired.
error.unbekannt: Check failed. Please try again later.

mfa.title: Security
mfa.description: Multi-factor authentication (requirement 4.9). A second factor via an authenticator app protects the account even if the password becomes known.
mfa.keineUmgebung: Without a Supabase environment there is no real account - multi-factor authentication only applies after signing in.
mfa.faktorenLead: One TOTP factor is enough. Several are possible, for instance for a backup device.
mfa.keinFaktor: No second factor set up yet.
mfa.schrittZweiLead: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Authy) or enter the secret manually, then confirm the displayed 6-digit code.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
mfa.qrHinweis: No scanner at hand? Enter the secret into the app manually:
mfa.erfolg: Second factor set up and active.
mfa.note: At the next sign-in the code will be requested in addition to the password. Without a configured factor, sign-in stays as before - multi-factor authentication is required by requirement 4.9, enforcing it per role is a later expansion step.

roles.viewAsHint: View as role - changes the presentation only; write permissions still follow your profile

descriptions.admin: Full configuration, user and role management, oversight of sensitive finance, access and integration matters.
descriptions.betriebsleitung: Daily plantation operations, tasks, rotation, staff and approvals. Can view finance but not post entries.
descriptions.buchhaltung: Contribution margin, pay, payments, state filings. No user management, no field sign-offs.
descriptions.brigade: Accepts picking tasks, records volume and photo evidence in the field, sees rotation and pre-harvest-interval locks.
descriptions.picker: Sees only their own picking performance and payslip. No write access to posted quantities or anyone else's data.
descriptions.erzeuger: Neighbouring farm supplying produce. Sees its own row blocks, batches, settlement and contracts.
descriptions.kunde: Quotas, pre-orders, price lists, AI chat, released documents and own complaints.

accessDenied.title: The role {role} has no access to this module.
accessDenied.hint: These modules are reserved for other roles. Contact your administrator if you need access.

rotationsplanAnsicht.uebersichtLead: Cyclical picking dates per row block. Locks and releases are taken automatically from treatments and pre-harvest intervals.

stat.ueberfaelligHinweis: Date has passed, no picking task yet
stat.gesperrtHinweis: Falls within an active pre-harvest-interval lock

rotationsplanAnsicht.tabelleLead: One week back to two weeks ahead, sorted by date. "Generate plan" plans further ahead even though not everything is shown here at once.
rotationsplanAnsicht.note: Weather scenarios (e.g. moving dates forward in heat) are not yet included - the weather integration (growing-degree-day calculation) itself is not built yet. The lock logic is complete: a new treatment automatically locks the affected dates, the release unlocks them again, and the first matching picking task marks a date as done.

generieren.lead: Continues the cycle per row block from the last planned or actual harvest date. Running it repeatedly creates no duplicates.

verlustquote.label: Loss rate from picking to the client
verlustquote.braucht: nothing - scrap per batch is recorded
verlustquote.basis: scrap against total quantity across all batches

zeitBisVorkuehlung.label: Time from picking to pre-cooling
zeitBisVorkuehlung.braucht: nothing - picking and cooling time per batch
zeitBisVorkuehlung.basis: average across all measured batches, including limit breaches

zeitBisKunde.label: Time from picking to the client

pflueckleistung.label: Picking output per person and hour
pflueckleistung.braucht: nothing - crate with person against working time
pflueckleistung.basis: harvest quantity per crate against recorded working time

pflueckStreuung.label: Spread of picking output (best to weakest)
pflueckStreuung.braucht: nothing - output per person across the season
pflueckStreuung.basis: strongest against weakest worker, at least two people required

pflueckintervall.label: Picking interval kept per row block
pflueckintervall.braucht: nothing - harvest sequence per row block from the batches
pflueckintervall.basis: share of actual harvest sequences within at most three days

behandlungenWartezeit.label: Treatments with the pre-harvest interval kept
behandlungenWartezeit.braucht: nothing - derivable from treatment and lock logic
behandlungenWartezeit.basis: treatments without harvesting during the lock period

belegteVerkaeufe.label: Share of documented sales (ЭСФ and accompanying document)
belegteVerkaeufe.braucht: connection to ЭСФ and the goods accompanying note

deckungsbeitrag.label: Contribution margin per kg
deckungsbeitrag.braucht: nothing - entries per batch against harvest quantity
deckungsbeitrag.basis: all revenue and cost entries against the total harvest quantity - still without a time window or batch reference per entry

esutdAbdeckung.label: Seasonal-worker coverage in ЕСУТД
esutdAbdeckung.braucht: legal confirmation of the ЕСУТД obligation via enbek.kz (see WMCNL-1447) - connection point named, the legal review of the obligation itself is still outstanding
esutdAbdeckung.basis: pickers with a recorded employment contract

websiteAnfragen.label: Enquiries via the website per month

standort.title: Location hierarchy
standort.description: Farm, plantation, field plot, row group, row block - a digital field map with a unique row and block identifier along the trellises.
standort.summary: Field map with row blocks on the trellis, variety, planting year, cane type and trellis orientation per block.
standort.todo: Admin interface to create and move plots and row groups, field-geometry editor.

reihenbloecke.title: Row blocks and status
reihenbloecke.description: Every row block has one status: planted, ready to harvest, dormant, pruning or harvest-locked. A locked block simply must not appear in the picking schedule.
reihenbloecke.summary: State machine per row block. A condition locks the harvest until it is met - here: until the pre-harvest interval expires.
reihenbloecke.todo: Status changes with a mandatory reason, fine-grained access rules per resource, history per row block.

pflueckaufgaben.title: Picking tasks with photo evidence
pflueckaufgaben.description: A picking task per brigade and row block with target and actual volume, quality factor and photo evidence of the retail punnet right on the task.
pflueckaufgaben.summary: Task per brigade and row block, photo evidence of the retail punnet, volume and quality factor on the task.
pflueckaufgaben.todo: Offline capture in the field, evidence review with release and rework, link to quality-factor pay.

pflanzenschutz.title: Plant protection and pre-harvest interval
pflanzenschutz.description: Every treatment is recorded with product, quantity, block, date and the person applying it, and locks the row block automatically until the statutory pre-harvest interval expires.
pflanzenschutz.summary: Block-level treatment records with an automatic harvest lock. A breach is a legal and food-safety risk.
pflanzenschutz.todo: Pesticide database with pre-harvest intervals, automatic release on deadline, mandatory record upload, residue proof per batch.

rotationsplan.title: Rotation plan / picking schedule
rotationsplan.description: A rolling picking schedule with an interval of two to three days per row block across the whole autumn harvest. One missed round destroys the block for that cycle.
rotationsplan.summary: The first function to be built. The planning problem is not the forecast but the rotation over six weeks.
rotationsplan.todo: Interval engine per row block, brigade assignment, conflict check against pre-harvest-interval locks, calendar export (.ics).

wetter.title: Weather and growing degree days
wetter.description: A weather API link with growing-degree-days calculation for the volume forecast. Deliberately no machine learning in phase 1 - an explainable heuristic is enough.
wetter.summary: A simple weather interface with growing degree days per plot. Explainable, verifiable and validatable within a season.
wetter.todo: Weather-station or API link, growing degree days per plot, alert on shifted ripening windows.

kuehlkette.title: Cold-chain clock
kuehlkette.description: Timing from picking to pre-cooling with a hard 60-minute threshold, temperature logger, target temperature 0 to 1 degree. Highest priority in the whole farm.
kuehlkette.summary: The building block the entire price spread hangs on. Over 60 minutes the ware is only industrial ware the next day.
kuehlkette.todo: Temperature-logger integration, batch clock from the picking time, alarm on threshold breach, KPI calculation.

logistik.title: Collection rounds and route planning
logistik.description: Fixed collection rounds in the field so filled crates do not sit in the sun, plus route planning by the clients' delivery windows.
logistik.summary: Handover receipt with volume and temperature reconciliation (pre-cooling and transport), unbroken cold-chain evidence all the way to the customer.
logistik.todo: Route list per vehicle and delivery time windows (requirement 3.5 part 1) are still missing.

qr_steigen.title: QR crate identification
qr_steigen.description: QR labels for crates (linking to the public origin lookup), picker ID badges carrying the person's own badge code without biometrics, and a sign-in-free wall poster - all generated server-side as SVG and print-ready via the browser print function.
qr_steigen.summary: The QR code carries identity from the field to the shop counter - the badge can be scanned by camera at the collection point to attribute a crate or work time to that person, instead of choosing them from a dropdown.
qr_steigen.todo: A camera scan of the crate labels themselves (not just the picker badge) is not part of this build-out.

esf.title: Electronic delivery note (ЭСФ)
esf.description: An electronic delivery note in line with the goods-accompanying-document obligation. Connected to the state ЭСФ system, no accounting of its own.
esf.summary: Evidence chain from the batch to the delivery note, status feedback from the state system. Mandatory integration.
esf.todo: Connection to ИС ЭСФ, evidence chain batch to delivery note, status feedback and retry.

rollen.title: Roles and permissions
rollen.description: Seven core roles, from administration through farm management and accounting to the brigade and the individual picker in the field, the grower and the B2B client - with a permission matrix over resources and actions.
rollen.summary: Roles as a clear data structure over resources by actions. New roles without touching the logic.
rollen.todo: User management, role assignment, fine-grained access rules per resource.

finanzen.title: Contribution margin and finance
finanzen.description: Cost centres per row block, cost objects per variety and per client. Contribution margin per kilogram, per row block, per variety and per harvest day - immutable postings.
finanzen.summary: Contribution margin per row block, variety and harvest day. Postings are immutable (append only).
finanzen.todo: Cost types per harvest day, B2B payment reconciliation, contribution-margin projection per variety.

personal.title: Picker register and brigades
personal.description: A person register with a picker ID badge, brigade assignment, output and quality factor per person across the season - the basis for bonuses, retraining and selection the following year.
personal.summary: Person register, brigade and picker ID badge, output and quality profile per person across the season.
personal.todo: ЕСУТД registration per contract, brigade planning, output history as the basis for pay calculation.

lohn.title: Quality-factor pay
lohn.description: A combined model of base pay, a volume component and a quality factor. A pure piece rate pushes for volume, squeezes berries and is value-destroying for the raspberry.
lohn.summary: Base pay plus volume plus a quality factor. The quality factor is not optional but a precondition.
lohn.todo: Minimum-wage anchoring, a rate editor with a UI-guided corridor preview, per-picker PDF pay slips, an advance account.

dokumente.title: Document management
dokumente.description: A secure store for spray records, ЕСУТД evidence, supply and framework contracts, grant dossiers and certificates - linked to the row block and the batch.
dokumente.summary: A categorised, secure document store linked to the row block and the batch.
dokumente.todo: Versioning, expiry and reminder logic, link to row block and batch.

compliance.title: Compliance cockpit
compliance.description: Processing purposes, consents, data incidents and third-party disclosures from five granular tables - reading and writing reserved to office roles only.
compliance.summary: Granular data-protection schema: processing purposes, consents, incidents and disclosures in one place.
compliance.todo: Legal references for Tax Code, AI Act, Digital Code, retention rules per data product, hosting-location review.

integrationen.title: State integrations
integrationen.description: Connectors to ЭСФ, virtual stock, ЕСУТД and the subsidy portals gosagro.kz and qoldau.kz. Accounting stays with a solution established in the country.
integrationen.summary: One connector per target system with status feedback and retry. No in-house accounting build.
integrationen.todo: Connectors per system, sandbox access, error and retry logic, queue monitoring.

foerdermittel.title: Grant application dossier
foerdermittel.description: Application templates, evidence lists and a deadline monitor for the Kazakh subsidy portals - eligibility as a by-product of ongoing bookkeeping.
foerdermittel.summary: Deadline monitor and per-dossier evidence documents are connected (requirement 4.12). Application templates and evidence checklists per grant programme remain open.
foerdermittel.todo: Application templates and evidence checklists per grant programme - a domain decision on what fields and evidence gosagro.kz/qoldau.kz actually require per programme.

sortenkatalog.title: Variety and quota catalogue
sortenkatalog.description: A catalogue of variety, harvest window (summer-bearing or everbearing), punnet weight, quota and price list - the basis for pre-order and the B2B portal.
sortenkatalog.summary: Variety, harvest window, punnet weight, quota and price in one place.
sortenkatalog.todo: Quota booking with reservation logic, price-list versions, client assignment.

b2b_portal.title: B2B portal
b2b_portal.description: A regular-client portal with quotas, pre-order with lead time, a price list by client group, delivery status, invoice history and complaint reporting.
b2b_portal.summary: Delivery status with handover receipt, price list, and pre-orders with manual office confirmation are connected.
b2b_portal.todo: Automatic quota consumption, price tiers by client group, and invoice history are still missing (open business decisions).

preislisten.title: Price lists
preislisten.description: Versioned price lists with tiered prices by client group and validity period.
preislisten.summary: Price tiers per client and period, versioned and with a validity date.
preislisten.todo: Versioned price lists, tiered prices, validity periods, client assignment.

aggregator.title: Aggregator / neighbouring farms
aggregator.description: Connecting neighbouring farms: the purchased volume becomes an invoice line, every buy-in batch is tracked separately and remains traceable to the supplying farm.
aggregator.summary: Neighbouring-farm onboarding, buy-in capture with its own batch, separate origin tracking, settlement.
aggregator.todo: Neighbouring-farm onboarding, buy-in capture with its own batch, settlement and payout.

schulungen.title: Training videos
schulungen.description: Multilingual, image-based short onboarding of seasonal workers on the phone - videos per core process, with pictures instead of text.
schulungen.summary: Short image-based videos per core process, multilingual, with progress tracking per person.
schulungen.todo: Video content per core process, Kazakh and Russian language versions, progress tracking per person.

kanaele.title: Contact channels
kanaele.description: Locally established contact channels and payment methods, shown publicly in the website footer. Display only, no connection to a real messenger or payment service.
kanaele.summary: WhatsApp, Kaspi QR and other channels as contact details - maintained by the office, hidden as a draft until then.
kanaele.todo: Enter the real account details for each channel.

reklamationen.title: Complaint management
reklamationen.description: A B2B client's complaint per batch - reason, deadline and history, with a status flow through to a credit note. A client reports and sees only their own complaint; the office handles and closes it.
reklamationen.summary: List, detail and history per complaint, linked to the batch - traceable from there to the row block, picker and cooling curve.
reklamationen.todo: Admin screen to link a client login to a B2B client record, automatic complaint rate in the KPI cockpit, notification as a deadline approaches.

stammdaten.title: Master data and tax numbers
stammdaten.description: Legal form and IIN or BIN for the farm itself, its supplying farms and its customers - the details that must appear on every document.
stammdaten.summary: A peasant farm carries an IIN, a legal entity a BIN. The check digit rejects a transposed number before it reaches an invoice.

pflanzenschutzVerwaltung.lead: The pre-harvest interval comes from the product catalogue - the row block is locked automatically.
pflanzenschutzVerwaltung.hinweis: The lock is set by a database trigger and cannot be bypassed by changing the status. The release button appears only once the pre-harvest interval has elapsed.

standortDemo.statsLead: Four levels below the farm: plantation, field plot, row group, row block.
standortDemo.treeLead: Farm, plantation, field plot, row group. Row blocks in their own module.
standortDemo.note: The field map with a unique row and block identifier along the trellises is the basis for the rotation plan, the harvest capture and the contribution margin.

pflanzenschutzDemo.ruleLead: After a plant-protection treatment, harvest is locked per row block until the product-specific pre-harvest interval expires. A breach is a legal risk, not a convenience matter.
pflanzenschutzDemo.activeLead: Row blocks with a running pre-harvest interval. Release is automatic when the deadline passes.
pflanzenschutzDemo.note: Because every block is picked every two to three days while the crop still has to be treated, a block can be harvested inside the pre-harvest interval by mistake. That is exactly what the automatic lock prevents.

rollenDemo.rolesLead: Administration, farm management, accounting, brigade in the field, picker, grower and B2B client. Each role sees exactly the modules it needs.
rollenDemo.matrixLead: Roles by resources - a clear data structure that allows new roles without touching the logic.
rollenDemo.matrixNote: Full matrix across all resources and actions. The database-level access rules are written per resource individually.
rollenDemo.note: Identities and roles run across all four areas - together with logging, encryption and multi-factor authentication.

finanzenAnsicht.uebersichtLead: Total across all cost objects and postings. Revenue and cost come from the immutable finance ledger (requirement 4.1).

stat.deckungsbeitragHinweis: Revenue minus cost, computed by the database

finanzenAnsicht.kostentraegerLead: Cost centre: row block. Cost object in the narrow sense: variety and client. One cost object can carry both at once.
finanzenAnsicht.chargeLead: Only batches with at least one posting recorded directly against the batch instead of only the cost object - a finer breakdown when one cost object bundles several batches of the same day.
finanzenAnsicht.ledgerLead: Append only: a wrong posting is corrected with a reversing entry, not by changing the original.
finanzenAnsicht.note: The contribution margin per kilogram is the central management metric (KPI "deckungsbeitrag"). It is formed per row block, variety, harvest day and client - not only at year end. Postings are immutable; the database rejects UPDATE and DELETE on the finance ledger regardless of the interface.

kostentraeger.lead: Row block, variety and client are each optional - at least one reference is required, otherwise the contribution margin cannot be attributed later.

buchung.lead: Revenue or cost for an existing cost object. The posting cannot be changed afterwards, only corrected with a reversing entry.

personalDemo.brigadenLead: Brigade planning with shifts and a reserve list across the whole harvest run.
personalDemo.pflueckerLead: Person register with a picker ID badge, ЕСУТД registration per contract, output and quality factor per person.
personalDemo.note: Keeping the core crew is more important than recruiting: every new onboarding in the middle of the season costs volume and quality.

dokumenteDemo.listLead: Spray records, ЕСУТД evidence, contracts, grant dossiers and certificates.
dokumenteDemo.note: Every document is linked to a row block or a batch. Residue proof per batch is therefore available at the press of a button for trade and authorities.

horizontalesMonitoring.lead: Kazakhstan abolished the tax authority's automated risk score - a voluntary model with a real benefit took its place.
horizontalesMonitoring.readinessText: Horizontal monitoring requires ongoing, structured visibility into a company's own accounting. Damicon already produces that trail by design:
horizontalesMonitoring.punktProtokoll: Every write lands in the audit log (audit_events) - including who did it and when.
horizontalesMonitoring.punktUnveraenderlich: Harvest bookings and batches become immutable once closed - no quiet after-the-fact edits.
horizontalesMonitoring.punktKuehlkette: The 60-minute cold-chain rule is evaluated live, not only checked in hindsight.
horizontalesMonitoring.vorteil: Late-payment fee: {ermaessigt} instead of {normal} of the National Bank base rate per day for horizontal-monitoring participants.
horizontalesMonitoring.hinweis: This is a statement about the data structure's readiness, not a claim that enrollment in horizontal monitoring has already happened - that step is its own deliberate application to the tax authority.

registrieren.lead: Record this once the registration has actually been filed with the tax office - not an automatic step.

farmReality.eyebrow: The farm, not a photo library
farmReality.title: Real footage instead of stock photos
farmReality.lead: These images show the plantation near Almaty before digitalisation - including what isn't right yet. A presence that shows only the successes reads to a buyer as advertising; one that names the open issue itself reads as a status report.
farmReality.bandCaption: The plantation, looking south toward the Zailiyskiy Alatau range
farmReality.photo1Text: Everbearing, fruits on first-year cane. Ripe and green berries hang at the same time - which is why every block is picked every two to three days.
farmReality.photo2Text: 5 to 15 minutes pass from picking to the cold room. That figure is good and does not need improving.
farmReality.photo3Text: The same ware in storage, poured loose at around +16 °C instead of near 0 °C. Raspberries carry no weight of their own: whatever lies beneath the top layer gets crushed - and at this temperature it keeps ripening.

existingAssets.title: This does not start at zero
existingAssets.lead: The farm has equipment, irrigation and its own product. What is missing is not equipment, but proof of what went where and when.
existingAssets.asset1Text: Own tractor for maintenance and transport.
existingAssets.asset2Text: Own spraying equipment. Every treatment triggers a pre-harvest interval - the system locks the block for it automatically.
existingAssets.asset3Text: Water storage and tanks on site, plus its own transformer station - power does not depend on the local grid.
existingAssets.asset4Text: Raspberry jam under its own label, bilingual. Second-choice fruit already has a path - exactly what a quality standard requires.

qualityStandard.eyebrow: The same standard as in the system
qualityStandard.title: The standard lives here, not in a brochure
qualityStandard.lead: Whoever picks for the farm or buys from it sees the same standard that applies in the system - the same criteria the picker's phone asks for. The technical basis is UNECE standard FFV-32 for raspberries.
qualityStandard.q1Text: Evenly coloured, hollow inside, the drupelets hold together. The receptacle stays on the cane.
qualityStandard.q2Text: The white receptacle is still lodged in the berry. It was pulled off by force instead of lifted away, and loses juice in transport.
qualityStandard.q3Text: Grey coating, even at just one spot. Stays in the field: inside a closed punnet it infects the whole layer overnight.
qualityStandard.trayTitle: The costliest mistake is a height
qualityStandard.trayText: Seen from above, the overfilled punnet looks best: full, dense, no gap. But the lid presses on the top layer, and the bottom layer carries the weight. Raspberries carry no weight of their own - by the time it's in the shop, the bottom layer is juice. That is visible only from the side.
qualityStandard.vergleichText: On the left an unblemished fruit, on the right one with grey mould - two photographs of the same variety, not the same berry. Drag the slider: the difference takes hours, not days, and in a closed punnet it spreads to the whole layer overnight.
qualityStandard.vergleichRegler: Move the comparison slider between the two photographs

lohnAnsicht.satzLead: Basis of the calculation: hourly rate, per-kg rate and the quality-factor corridor. Whoever is paid by it may see the basis.
lohnAnsicht.keinSatz: No pay rate on file yet - no period can be calculated without one.
lohnAnsicht.wirkungslos: The quality factor does not move away from 1.00 across the settlements shown - it currently has no visible effect on pay here. This can be due to missing waste data, not necessarily the formula.

stat.zielHinweis: At this rate the factor equals 1.00

lohnAnsicht.abrechnungenLead: One row per picker and period. Base pay and volume component shown separately, so the total stays verifiable.
lohnAnsicht.positionenLead: How the volume component is made up per task - the basis for allocating the task's waste.
lohnAnsicht.note: Waste is only recorded per picking task, not per crate or person - the share per picker is therefore an allocation by kg share, not a directly measured individual value. The quality factor calculated here is a separate, objective pay factor derived from the waste rate and does not replace the quality factor management maintains manually on the picking task itself - both answer different questions.

satz.lead: An existing, still open rate is automatically closed at the new start date.

berechnen.lead: Calculates base pay, volume component and quality factor per picker for the chosen period. Already approved or paid settlements stay unchanged.

abzuegeBerechnen.lead: Aggregates the selected calendar month's payroll entries per picker and records ОПВ/ВОСМС/ИПН plus the employer burden. Running it again for the same month replaces the rows rather than duplicating them.

kz.lead: ОПВ (pension), ВОСМС (medical insurance) and ИПН (income tax) per calendar month, plus the additional employer burden (ОПВР/СО/СН/ОСМС). Calculated under the RK Tax Code 2026 – an approximation for the standard case, see the note below.
kz.keinSatz: No statutory deduction rate on file yet.
kz.note: Approximation for the standard case: the standard 30 МРП deduction is applied by default (the law requires a written request for it), special allowances (disability, war veterans) are not modelled, and СН is shown here as a flat percentage without the СО offset that earlier versions of the law applied. Does not replace review by a qualified accountant.

stat.opvHinweis: Employee side, capped at the assessment ceiling
stat.vosmsHinweis: Employee side, capped at the assessment ceiling
stat.arbeitgeberlastHinweis: ОПВР + СО + СН + ОСМС, on top of gross pay

zukaufAnsicht.statsLead: KPIs across all recorded purchase positions from neighbouring farms.

stat.offenePreiseHinweis: Invoice from the neighbouring farm not received yet.

zukaufAnsicht.listLead: Each position carries its own batch without a row block - separate origin tracking, traceable back to the supplying farm.
zukaufAnsicht.keinRecht: Your role may read the purchasing data, but not import or add prices. That is reserved for management and administration.
zukaufAnsicht.note: Volume, variety, date and neighbouring farm come from the CSV import. The price is deliberately left open at import time - it is added once the neighbouring farm's invoice arrives. A self-service login for the neighbouring farm itself is not connected yet.

import.lead: Paste volume, variety, date and neighbouring farm - one row per delivery. Delimiter and header language are detected automatically.
import.hilfe: Required columns: volume (kg), variety, date, neighbouring farm. Unknown variety or farm names are not created automatically.

befund.value_format: Row {zeile}: value at "{spalte}" is not recognised: {wert}
befund.value_range: Row {zeile}: value at "{spalte}" is outside the valid range: {wert}
befund.value_suspicious: Row {zeile}: unusual value at "{spalte}", imported anyway: {wert}
befund.unknown_reference: Row {zeile}: "{wert}" is unknown at "{spalte}" and is not created automatically.
befund.duplicate_verdacht: Row {zeile}: matches row {wert} - possibly a duplicate entry, imported anyway.

betriebAufnehmen.lead: A farm must be listed here before the CSV import accepts its rows.
betriebAufnehmen.name: Name

abrechnungAnsicht.lead: Purchase value per partner farm minus the globally set margin - no quality-grade deductions as long as there is no quality classification for purchased produce.
abrechnungAnsicht.keineZeilen: No purchase line with a recorded price yet from which a settlement could be calculated.
abrechnungAnsicht.hinweis: The margin applies uniformly to all partner farms. As long as it is at 0 %, the payout equals the purchase value - no invented margin.

tourenplanungAnsicht.lead: Build delivery rounds from several deliveries, sequence and distance optimized automatically (OSRM/OpenStreetMap).
tourenplanungAnsicht.hinweis: The route is an estimate from the routing service, not a basis for working-time or fuel billing. Vehicle capacity and time windows are not part of this first stage.

erstellen.lead: Select deliveries and set a day. The sequence is optimized automatically when saved.

etiketten.title: Crate labels
etiketten.lead: QR code and plain-text code for each crate, print-ready. The QR code links to the public origin lookup for the crate's batch.
etiketten.empty: No crate with a linked batch yet.

ausweise.title: Picker ID badges
ausweise.lead: A QR code per picker with the person's own badge code - scannable by camera at the collection point to attribute a crate or work time to that person. Deliberately without a photo or biometrics.

aushang.hinweis: There is also a sign-in-free wall poster for the farm with a QR code to the general code entry page.

ausweisScan.label: Picker
ausweisScan.hinweis: Hold the badge QR code in front of the camera.
ausweisScan.keinTreffer: This code does not belong to any known picker. Please scan the correct badge.
ausweisScan.keineKamera: Camera access is not possible. Please choose manually.

einarbeitungAnsicht.leadEigen: Six steps for getting started in the harvest season. Each step can be checked off individually, progress is saved.
einarbeitungAnsicht.leadReferenz: Six steps of the quick onboarding checklist for pickers, shown here as reference material in your own language.

pflichtschulungenAnsicht.lead: Training that must be refreshed every year with proof of attendance, for example workplace safety. "Due soon" and "overdue" follow the validity period set on each training.
pflichtschulungenAnsicht.keineZeilen: No mandatory training set up yet.

foerdermittelAnsicht.lead: Status and deadline per dossier, with attached evidence documents. Application templates per grant programme are deliberately not part of this view (a domain decision).
foerdermittelAnsicht.note: Grant dossiers are a by-product of ongoing bookkeeping, not a standalone application system. Evidence documents are attached via the documents module.

anlegen.lead: Portal and title are required, everything else can be added later.

aktualisieren.lead: Maintain status, deadline, submission date and notes of an existing dossier.

lieferungenAnsicht.lead: Digital handover receipt: quantity, recipient and the batch's cold chain at the moment of handover.
lieferungenAnsicht.note: A delivered or cancelled delivery is immutable, a correction is only possible as a new delivery.
lieferungenAnsicht.empfaengerNamePlatzhalter: Name of the person receiving the delivery

anlegen.lead: Customer and quantity are required, the batch can optionally be assigned.

b2bPortalAnsicht.lieferungenLead: Status and handover receipt of your deliveries.
b2bPortalAnsicht.rechnungenLead: Calculated from delivered quantity and the price list valid on the delivery date - not a legally binding invoice.
b2bPortalAnsicht.keineRechnungen: No delivered shipment yet from which a pro forma could be calculated.
b2bPortalAnsicht.rechnungenHinweis: This overview does not replace an invoice from accounting. It shows what a delivery would have amounted to under the price list valid at the time.
b2bPortalAnsicht.kontingenteLead: Agreed quantity per variety and reserved share - reserved automatically when a pre-order is confirmed.
b2bPortalAnsicht.keineKontingente: No quota on file at the moment.
b2bPortalAnsicht.preislisteLead: Currently valid price list by variety, with minimum quantity.
b2bPortalAnsicht.keinePreisliste: No valid price list on file at the moment.
b2bPortalAnsicht.vorbestellungenLead: A pre-order is a request - the office confirms or declines it, checked against the known quota status.

anlegen.lead: Variety and quantity are required, the delivery date is a preferred date.

b2bPortalAnsicht.note: When the office confirms a pre-order, the reserved share of the quota is increased automatically; a cancellation reverses it. Whether enough quota remains available is still checked by the office itself before confirming. The price list shows the prices that apply to your own client group, plus the group-less standard list. Prices for other client groups stay hidden.

preislistenAnsicht.preislistenLead: Prices by variety and minimum quantity, optionally assigned to a client group. A price list without a client group counts as the standard for everyone - including clients not yet assigned to a group.
preislistenAnsicht.keinePositionen: No position in this price list yet.
preislistenAnsicht.kundengruppenLead: Every B2B client belongs to at most one client group. Without an assignment, the client sees only the group-less standard price list.
preislistenAnsicht.hinweis: When price lists overlap for the same client group and variety, the one with the later valid-from date applies. An existing price list is never deleted, only deactivated - it stays authoritative for invoice histories (pro forma) already calculated.

erstellen.lead: Name and valid-from date are required. Without a client group, the list counts as the standard for everyone.
erstellen.name: Name

sortenkatalogAnsicht.sortenLead: Master data per variety: type, harvest window and punnet size.
sortenkatalogAnsicht.verfuegbarkeitLead: Sum across all clients per variety and season, without any individual client assignment.
sortenkatalogAnsicht.verfuegbarkeitHinweis: This overview shows no assignment to individual clients - a B2B client still sees their own reservation in their own portal.
sortenkatalogAnsicht.kontingenteLead: Create or change the agreed quantity per client, variety and season. The reserved quantity is updated automatically by the system whenever a pre-order is confirmed or cancelled.
sortenkatalogAnsicht.hinweis: A variety is never deleted, only edited - price lists and quotas reference it. A quota also stays on file even when nothing is reserved against it anymore.

sorteErstellen.lead: Name and type are required, harvest window and punnet size are optional.
sorteErstellen.name: Name

kontingentErstellen.lead: Client, variety and quantity are required, the season is a free-text field (e.g. a year).

personalAnsicht.brigadenLead: Crew planning with shifts and a reserve list across the whole harvest area.
personalAnsicht.bedarfLead: For each planned harvest day: how many row blocks in total, already assigned to a crew, and still open.
personalAnsicht.keinBedarf: No harvest days planned for the coming days.
personalAnsicht.offeneTermineLead: Row blocks without an assigned crew - assign a crew directly here.
personalAnsicht.einsatzplanLead: Which crew is scheduled for how many row blocks on which day.
personalAnsicht.keinEinsatzplan: No shifts planned for the coming days.
personalAnsicht.pflueckerLead: Personnel roster with picker badge, ЕСУТД record per contract, performance and quality factor per person.
personalAnsicht.reservelisteLead: Pickers without a current crew assignment, available on call.
personalAnsicht.keineReserve: No picker currently without a crew assignment.
personalAnsicht.note: Demand calculation and shift plan come directly from the rotation plan (which row block must be harvested on which day). Weather scenarios are deliberately not part of this view - the weather connection (requirement 2.13) has been deferred.

sechzig.title: 60 minutes decide the price
sechzig.lead: Scroll through the hour after picking. The clock starts with the scan in the field, and the curve shows the heat leaving the fruit.

pfluecken.title: Picked straight into the punnet
pfluecken.text: The berry goes from the hand into the retail punnet. When the crate is handed over, one scan captures volume, row block, time and person. The clock starts here.

kuehlraum.title: In the cold room after 5 to 15 minutes
kuehlraum.text: That is how long it takes today from picking to the cold room. The figure is good and does not need improving.

vorkuehlung.title: Cooled down to 0 to 1 degree
vorkuehlung.text: The heat has to leave the fruit, not just the room. Only then does the cold slow down ripening and grey mould.

beleg.title: The cooling curve is on record
beleg.text: Time and temperature are attached to the batch. If the 60-minute limit is broken, the farm sees it before the buyer does.

belegkette.startText: The code on the punnet opens the chain back to its origin.

lupe.hinweisMaus: Magnifier: move the mouse over the photo

scan.title: The farm in three dimensions
scan.lead: A 3D scan of the farm, recorded on site. Rotate, zoom and view the row blocks from any angle.
scan.bedienung: Drag to rotate, scroll or pinch to zoom
scan.fehler: The 3D walkthrough could not be loaded.

einladungenAnsicht.lead: A B2B customer account is only created through an invitation. The code is shown once and stored as a checksum only.

formular.lead: The code is valid for 14 days and only for the address entered here.
formular.name: Contact name

code.hinweis: Write it down now and hand it to the customer. The server keeps only the checksum - once you leave this page the code cannot be shown again. If it is lost, withdraw the invitation and issue a new one.
code.wo: Redeem at {url} - pass on this address together with the code.

einladungenAnsicht.gekuerzt: Showing {gezeigt} of {gesamt} invitations, open ones first. Older redeemed and withdrawn entries are not listed here.

einladungSeite.codeHinweis: Case does not matter and the hyphens are optional.
einladungSeite.emailHinweis: Exactly the address the invitation was issued to.
einladungSeite.demoLead: Without a database there is no access to set up. This page only works in database mode.
einladungSeite.angemeldetLead: A new access is issued for its own account. Sign out first, otherwise you will keep working in the old one.

stammdatenAnsicht.lead: A peasant farm (KH/FH) carries an IIN, a legal entity a BIN. Both are twelve digits long, so each legal form states which of the two applies.
stammdatenAnsicht.note: The twelfth digit is a check digit. If it does not match, the system rejects the number - a transposed digit shows up on entry, not on the invoice.

gruppeLead.betrieb: Without this number the farm cannot issue a document of its own.
gruppeLead.kunde: Required for invoice and delivery note.

steigeScan.label: Crate at the collection point
steigeScan.hinweis: Hold the crate label in front of the camera.
steigeScan.keineKamera: No camera available. Enter the code by hand.
steigeScan.keinSteigenCode: This code carries no crate number.
steigeScan.nichtInDieserAufgabe: {code} does not belong to this picking task.

pflanzenschutzProtokoll.lead: Every recorded plant-protection treatment with dose, operator and waiting period. Entry and release happen at the row block.
pflanzenschutzProtokoll.note: The protocol upload is not built yet: the protocol document column stays empty for now.
pflanzenschutzProtokoll.gekuerzt: Showing the latest {anzahl} treatments, the figures above count all of them.
pflanzenschutzProtokoll.personVerborgenHinweis: The operator's name is only visible to the office.
